scripts.build: npm run -w front-end build && npm run -w back-end build
scripts.lint-server: npm run -w back-end lint-fix && npm run -w back-end server
scripts.lint-serve: npm run -w front-end lint-fix && npm run -w front-end serve
scripts.lint: eslint "scripts/**/*.mjs" eslint.toolchain.config.mjs && npm run lint:toolchain && npm run -w front-end lint && npm run -w back-end lint
scripts.lint:toolchain: eslint --config eslint.toolchain.config.mjs "scripts/*build-toolchain*.mjs" scripts/check-toolchain-package.mjs scripts/test-npm-tool-majors.mjs scripts/test-picomatch-compat.mjs scripts/test-picomatch-install.mjs vendor/picomatch/repeated-output.cjs back-end/scripts/run-typescript.mjs
scripts.lint-fix: eslint "scripts/**/*.mjs" eslint.toolchain.config.mjs --fix && npm run lint:toolchain -- --fix && npm run -w front-end lint-fix && npm run -w back-end lint-fix
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w front-end typecheck && npm run -w back-end typecheck
scripts.test: npm run -w front-end test:unit && npm run -w back-end test:unit && npm run test:build-toolchain && npm run test:toolchain-package
scripts.test:build-toolchain: node --test --test-concurrency=1 scripts/test-build-toolchain.mjs scripts/test-build-toolchain-cache.mjs scripts/test-build-toolchain-seed.mjs scripts/test-npm-tool-majors.mjs scripts/test-picomatch-compat.mjs scripts/test-picomatch-install.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run check:build-toolchain && npm run check:toolchain-package && npm run check:local-archives && npm run check:native-bindings && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:repo && npm test && npm run test:runtime-artifact && npm run build && npm run verify:deploy-assets && npm run verify:site
